note: Minimized from t3code apps/web/src/components/preview/previewBridge.ts (230fd2f9). With `window` handed to the split (EK4402 `window is platform code`), the private const nativePreviewBridge moved to previewBridge.platform.ts and came back as an import. TypeScript does not narrow an import inside a closure, so the kept `nativePreviewBridge ? { ...: async () => nativePreviewBridge.captureScreenshot() } : null` failed TS18047 on the a444 compiler (platform-t3code web proof). Contracts and Schema decoding are replaced by a local type.
